verdict.rationale: CodeRabbit's own Request Changes Workflow (reviews.request_changes_workflow) submits a request-changes review whenever it posts actionable inline comments, and approves only once approval requirements are met. Its docs show a GitHub PR blocked by that review, which gates merges until findings and Pre-Merge Checks are resolved. Missing for 10: no severity threshold that blocks only on critical findings (it blocks on any actionable comment), no evidence of a separate required status check, enforcement shown only on GitHub, and no independent or hands-on confirmation of the blocking behavior.

support.subject: As an engineering lead, the reviewer can gate merges — a required status check or blocking review that enforces resolution of critical findings

citations.quote: When enabled, CodeRabbit requests changes when a review posts actionable inline comments and approves the pull request after the approval requirements are met
A GitHub pull request blocked by CodeRabbit's request-changes review
Use request changes workflow to keep review decisions synchronized with resolved feedback, completed reviews, and Pre-Merge Checks.
